summary: Verified all 4 Vesikalık bug fixes in the real Fotuber repo. Tests performed against the live preview URL with pixel-level canvas.getImageData sampling on [data-testid=canvas-single] (591x709) and [data-testid=canvas-sheet] (1181x1772). Login/nav OK. face-api + @imgly models loaded from CDN successfully. BUG1 (watermark in single middle band tied to wmScale), BUG2(a) (adjustments skip bg after bg-remove), BUG3 (recolor/redeye/sharpen no ReferenceError + keepCrop keeps framing), and BUG4 (dashed gray cut lines spanning full paper) all PASS. BUG2(b) — color-key fallback WITHOUT bg-removal — is fuzzy for non-uniform-corner crops (see rca).

regression.bg_remove_btn: Arka Planı Temizle triggers @imgly bg removal; bg-removed-badge appears in ~6s

bug2b_observation.test_conditions: auto-bg toggled OFF; fresh upload; adj-brightness 100→140, contrast 100→140, warmth 0→40; portrait1.jpg (face crop where bottom corners of the 591x709 output contain the person, not plain background)
bug2b_observation.root_cause: buildColorKeyMask averages the 4 corner pixels of the CROPPED single-canvas. For a portrait face-crop, the BOTTOM corners typically contain the subject (bl=74, br=114), while the TOP corners contain background (tl=231, tr=240). Averaging yields a meaningless midtone (~165), so the color-distance tolerance=60 misclassifies BOTH background AND skin/clothing pixels: (a) top-left/right white bg pixels are treated as FOREGROUND (distance from avg > 60) and get brightness/contrast applied → bg NOT stable (tl 231→255); (b) mid-skin body pixel (211,174,137) is treated as BACKGROUND (distance ≈55 < 60) and is skipped → person actually undertreated in that region.
bug2b_observation.impact: When users skip background removal AND their crop's corners are not a uniform plain background, the İnce Ayar sliders visibly affect the top edges of the preview (visible brightening). BUG2(a) with imgly bg removal is unaffected and works perfectly.
bug2b_observation.verdict: Partial. The requirement says 'roughly stable' for the fallback, but for portrait crops (common case) tl/tr can brighten by 64 units — visible. Consider sampling from a wider padded region OUTSIDE the crop (from image.el at padding), OR using per-corner tolerance (only use corners that agree with each other), OR just always compute fgMask via a lightweight seg model when autoBg is OFF.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Improve buildColorKeyMask for portrait crops — either sample from padded area outside the crop rect (image.el neighborhood), reject corners that disagree by >tol, or fall back to a saliency-based FG mask. Current implementation only works when all 4 corners are a plain color.

MINOR: A transient 'Model yüklenemedi. İnternet bağlantınızı kontrol edin.' toast appeared once mid-test (visible in the final screenshot near the top-right). Likely runAutoDetect firing on a spec/image transition when face-api models briefly failed to fetch. Non-blocking — recolor/redeye/sharpen still succeeded. Consider suppressing the toast when the models load lazily and a subsequent call succeeds.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPassportPhoto.jsx is 929 lines — approaching the 700-line ceiling. Consider extracting drawSingle/drawSheet into /lib/passportDraw.js and the buildColorKeyMask + fgMask logic into /lib/fgMask.js.

buildColorKeyMask uses a hard-coded tolerance of 60 and only 4 single-pixel corner samples. As documented in bug2b_observation, this is a fragile fallback. Safer: average 3x3 patches at each corner and compute per-corner distance stddev; if stddev is high (bg is not uniform), abort the fallback and skip masking entirely (accept the whole-image filter) rather than mis-mask.

drawSingle's masked-filter approach is elegant but rebuilds the offscreen canvas + colorKey mask on EVERY slider tick. On 591x709 that's fine, but on 5MP+ source images this could jank. Consider memoizing the color-key mask (only rebuild when crop or image changes, not on every adj change).

In drawSheet, cut lines: the 'x -= off' and 'x -= gap' branches when c==cols/rows shift the outermost lines slightly INWARD relative to a true paper-edge cut. In this test with gap=0 it collapses to a no-op, but for gap>0 the outermost cut line lands just INSIDE the block, not at the block edge. If the intent is 'cut lines reach paper edges', consider also drawing lines at x=0 and x=pw regardless.

rca_of_the_issue: See bug2b_observation above. The color-key fallback fails on portrait crops with non-uniform corners. All 4 originally reported bugs are fixed and verified; this is a residual quality issue in the fallback path only, not a regression.
